title: Understanding $$sort_{values}$$
text: The $$`sort_{values}`$$ function is used to sort the DataFrame based on the values of a specified column. In this case, it's sorting by column 'a'. What does $$`ascending=False`$$ imply about the order of sorting?

title: Using head(1)
text: The `head(1)` function returns the first row of the DataFrame after sorting. Consider what the first row would be after sorting column 'a' in descending order.

title: Accessing column 'b'
text: After sorting and using `head(1)`, you access column 'b'. Which value from column 'b' corresponds to the first row of the sorted DataFrame?

title: Final Step: iloc[0]
text: Now, use `iloc[0]` to get the first value of the Series obtained from the previous step. What is this value?
